summary: IDS feed s085_single is severely overloaded: 3.70 Gbps bursts on 1 Gbps port (370% capacity). All other visibility checks healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering ~3.7 Gbps micro-bursts to a 1 Gbps IDS port with no load balancing or rate control - 2 intervals exceeded 80% threshold, peaking at 370% of port capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS will drop packets at ingress due to buffer overrun, causing missed signatures, incomplete flow reassembly and blind spots for detection despite needing full payload and bidirectional traffic.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute 3.7 Gbps bursts across multiple 1 Gbps IDS members with flow-aware hashing to keep per-tool load <80% and preserve complete bidirectional flows for detection.
